mainEntity.name: What is weightlifting technique training and why is it important?

acceptedAnswer.text: Weightlifting technique training focuses on perfecting the movements involved in lifts like squats, deadlifts, presses, and Olympic lifts. Proper technique minimizes injury risk, improves strength and power output, and enhances overall efficiency. At Cave Training, our coaches emphasize foundational movement patterns to ensure you build a strong and safe lifting practice, helping you progress effectively in your functional fitness journey.
acceptedAnswer.description: Weightlifting technique training perfects lifting movements to prevent injury and improve performance. It's crucial for safe and effective functional fitness progression.
